metadata.title: Supra Interact | Mafi Kyakkyawan Mai Ma'amala da Smart Contract
metadata.description: Kwararrun mai ma'amala da smart contracts, yanayin gwaji, da kuma kayan aikin mu'amala waɗanda aka gina musanya ga tsarin Supra. Haɗa walat ɗinka, bincika modules, ka kuma aiwatar da ma'amoli ba tare da matsala ba a kan Testnet da Mainnet.
metadata.keywords: Supra, Blockchain, Smart Contracts, Explorer, DApp, SupraOracles, Move Language, Web3, Hoglet DAO

Governance.title: Sarakai da decentralization
Governance.subtitle: Deploy ko kayan aiki ba tare da maɗanin ba, ka ba EOA wanda yake zuwa DAO, ka kuma yi rashin mallakar sarakai tare da tabbacin cryptographic.
Governance.factoryNotPublished: Babban masauyin sarakaina ba a wallafa ba tukuna. Sanya NEXT_PUBLIC_GOVERNANCE_FACTORY zuwa adireshin kayan aiki da ka wallafa.
Governance.statusHint: An samo shi daga bayanai cryptographic na on-chain, ba daga wani alamar da kai ka faɗa ba.
Governance.statusRenounced: An yi rashin mallakar: an makale shi da tsaro
Governance.statusDaoGoverned: DAO tana sarƙewa: makale ya mutu, an ba da haƙuri
Governance.statusHazard: Hadari: maɗanin sirri yana nan a baye
Governance.factImmutable: Ba za iya canza shi da sau
Governance.factAdminIsContract: Mai gadinwa yana da lambar kayan aiki (ba EOA ba)
Governance.predictSubtitle: Duba adireshi kafin a wallafa ko a ba da kayan aiki.
Governance.actionsSubtitle: Kowane shigarra yana buɗe Interactor tare da babban masauyi a cikin.
Governance.actionDeploy: Wallafa sabo kayan aiki a cikin asarun resources marar maɗuwa.
Governance.actionDonate: Ba da EOA da yake zuwa DAO ta waki da za a iya soke.
Governance.actionUpgrade: Wallafa sabo sigar kayan aiki da ake sarƙewa.
Governance.actionRenounce: Yi rashin mallakar da lara da haƙurin saɗawa da ba da jimawa ba.
Governance.actionDeepFreeze: Wallafa lambar kayan aiki na ƙarshe da soke gayewar kanka.
Governance.emptyTitle: Babai wani adireshi aka aunawa ba
Governance.emptyHint: Sanya adireshin saƙo ko EOA don karanta ainihin hali na sarƙaima: ko maɗanin sirri yana nan a baye, wa ke shi mai gadinwa, ko za a iya canza lamarin a sake.
Governance.hazardDetail: Maɗanin sirri na wannan adireshi yana nan a baye, don haka mai haɗawa asali zai iya tsayar da DAO: ya buga ma'amoli kai tsaye ko ya soke haƙurin da aka ba da. Kada ka ɗauki wannan modul a matsayin rarrabawa har sai maɗanin ya larder.
Governance.actionTransfer: Yi mayar da muƙin mai gadinwa ga wataƙoƙoƙin adireshi.
Governance.burnBody: Wannan ita ce kira sauyin da ke saƙin yin kasuwanci gaske. Yana maye da maɗanin tabbatar da wannan adireshi da kasin byte 32 na babu bayan. Bayan haka babu wani da zai iya sake saƙin da shi — ko kai, ko maƙin da ya fara da shi.
Governance.burnAssetWarning: Kowane kudi, kayan fansa ko NFT da yake cikinsa a cikin wannan adireshi za a iya babu amfanin da shi har abada. Kana amfanye a kashe asusun da farko.
Governance.burnGateSwept: Na fitar da duk dukan kayan daga wannan adireshi.
Governance.burnGateUnderstood: Na fahimci cewa maɗanin sirri za a larda shi kuma ba za a iya dawo da shi.
Governance.burnDoneHint: Maɗanin tabbatar yanzu babu ne. Sake gudawa na bincike don ganin sabin hali: ko an yi ranka da shi na har abada, ko DAO take sarƙewa tare da babu mafida.
Governance.burnFailed: Ba a iya aika da sauya maɗanin ba
Governance.actionBurn: Gude maɗaninka: juya wannan adireshi zuwa ZERO_AUTH_KEY, matan da ke saƙin cikawar da gaske.
Governance.stage_unmanaged: Matan 1 · ba a sarƙe shi ba
Governance.factFactoryManaged: An yi rijista a wannan masauyi
Governance.runnerConnectWallet: Hauɗi walat don gudu rayuwa a kan adireshinka.
Governance.runnerUnmanagedBody: Wannan adireshi bai taɓa da bayan a masauyi ba. Deploy ko kayan aiki marar maɗuwa, ko kuma ba da EOA mai zuwa ga DAO.
Governance.runnerDualMasterBody: Maɗaninka yana nan a baye, don haka za ka iya tsayar da mai gadinwa. Gude shi a kasa don yin tafiarmar da aika.
Governance.runnerGovernedBody: Maɗanin ya fushi, kuma DAO tana da muƙin mai gadinwa. Akwai haɓa, canza mai gadinwa da kuma kare na karshe.
Governance.runnerFrozenBody: Wannan adireshi ba za a iya canza shi da sau ba. Babu signer, capability ko offer — komai zai fada.
Governance.deployFormHint: Yana ƙirƙiri asarun resources ba tare da maɗanin sirri, kuma yana ba da shi ga mai gadinwa.
Governance.fieldDaoAdminHint: Adireshin da zai sarƙewa. Kada ya kasance wannan walat, in ba hannan sarƙai za ta makale.
Governance.fieldMetadataHint: package-metadata.bcs daga babban faldi na build.
Governance.fieldNewAdminHint: Yi mayar da muƙin mai gadinwa ga DAO, timelock ko multisig.
Governance.transferFormTitle: Yi mayar da muƙin mai gadinwa
Governance.transferFormHint: Mataki daya mai atomic. Babu tabbatar da kuma biyu, don haka kuskure ba za a iya gyara shi ba.
Governance.transferFormWarning: Idan sabon mai gadinwa ya yi kuskure ko ba a iya isa shi ba, babu wani da zai iya sake sarƙewa.
Governance.deepFreezeFormHint: Yana wallafa ƙarshe na bytecode a {address} sannan yana lara duk signers.
Governance.deepFreezeFormWarning: Sigar da za a tafi a nan za ta kasance ta har abada. Bayan haka ba za a iya sake sabunta kayan aiki ba.
Governance.deepFreezeFormAck: Na fahimci cewa wannan bytecode shi ne karshe kuma ba za a maye shi ba.
Governance.renounceFormHint: Yana lara da haƙurin saƙawa na {address} da ba da jimawa ba.
Governance.renounceFormWarning: An lara da haƙurin da aka adana, an kuma soke gayewar da aka ba da. Babu wani da zai iya canza shi, ko ma sabo sigar masauyi.
Governance.donateFormTitle: Ba da wannan EOA ga DAO
Governance.donateFormHint: Ma'amala daya. Masauyi da kansa yana kira `offer_signer_capability` na framework a madinka — abin da kake buƙata shi ne shaidar aika wacce maɗanin sirrinka kaɗai zai iya samarwa.
Governance.donateSignHint: Yana karanta lambar jeri da wannan ma'amala za ta cinye, kuma yana saƙin kayan da framework ke tabbata.
Governance.donateSubmitHint: Yana rijista aika a masauyi domin DAO ta iya sarƙe wannan adireshi.
Governance.donateProofNote: Saƙi ne kawai. Babu gas, babu ma'amala. Aikan na aika ma'amalar kyauta ɗaya da ke ɗauke da shi.
Governance.burnFrameworkOnly: Masauyi ba zai iya yin wannan a madinka ba. `rotate_authentication_key_call` an ayyana ta `entry` (ba `public` ba) a framework, don haka Move ya hana kiranta daga wata modul — mai maɗanin ne kaɗai zai iya aika ta kai tsaye. Sauran matakai na wannan rayuwa, kwangila ke tsara su, domin ayyukan da yake buƙata na public ne.
Governance.burnOwnerOnly: Mai shi kaɗai zai iya lada wannan maɗanin, don haka haɗa walat ɗin wannan adireshi.
Governance.burnModalTitle: Ba za a iya juya wannan ba
Governance.selfRenounceTitle: Ko kuma yi rashin mallaka ga wannan EOA kai tsaye
Governance.selfRenounceBody: Gude maɗanin ba tare da DAO a hanya ba. Wannan shi ne hanyar rashin mallaka da kai: adireshin ya zama marar canzawa har abada, babu bayan a masauyi kuma babu mai iya yi masa komai. Ka sani yana rufe hanyar DAO — da maɗanin ya tafi ba za ka iya ba da haƙuri ba.
Governance.cancelDelegationBody: Yana soke kyautar: yana soke haƙurin da ka bayar ga waki kuma yana cire bayan masauyi, yana barin wannan EOA 'yanci a sake ba da ita. Yi amfani da shi idan ka zaɓi kuskure mai gadinwa na DAO ko ka ba da daga walat mara kyau.
Governance.cancelDelegationWindow: Ana iya ne kawai sa'ad da maɗaninka yana raye. Abin da ya sa hakan yiwu shi ne irin hadarin da lada ke cirewa — da maɗanin ya larder, tafiarmar ta zama ta ƙarshe kuma DAO ce kaɗai za ta iya yin rashin mallaka.
Governance.cancelDelegationOwnerOnly: Mai wannan maɗanin ne kaɗai zai iya soke tafiarmarsa, don haka haɗa walat ɗin wannan adireshi.
Governance.cancelDelegationDoneHint: An soke duka gayeyar kuma an cire bayan masauyi. Za a iya sake ba da wannan EOA duk lokacin da kake so.
Governance.cancelDelegationFailed: Ba a iya soke tafiarmar ba
Governance.burnPreviewNote: Adireshin da aka duba ba walat ɗinka ba ne, don haka wannan duba ne na karatu kawai ga allon lada. Haɗa wancan walat don kunna shi.
Governance.burnConnectHint: Walat ɗin da ka haɗa dole ya mallaki adireshin da aka duba — maɗanin ne kaɗai ke saɓin lada.
Governance.burnGatesHint: Danna duka shaidu biyu a sama don ci gaba.
Governance.burnAuditWallet: Yi amfani da walat na {address} maimakon
Governance.burnAuditWalletHint: Yana sauya bincike zuwa walat dinka da aka haɗa, don haka wannan allon ya zama mai rai kuma a iya saɓin lada da shi.
Governance.burnReauditHint: Yana sake karanta sarkar don nuna sabon matan. Ba a aika komai ba.
